metadata.title: Multiplicity of closed geodesics on odd-dimensional bumpy Finsler compact space form
metadata.abstract: Let $M = S^{2n+1}/\Gamma$ be a manifold diffeomorphic to a compact space form, endowed with a bumpy Finsler metric $F$. In this paper, we prove that there exist at least $n+3$ contractible minimal closed geodesics on $M$, assuming that all contractible minimal closed geodesics have non-zero Morse indices. Here, a contractible closed geodesic is called minimal if it is not an iteration of any other contractible closed geodesic. In particular, this confirms the generalized Anosov-Katok conjecture for the bumpy quotient manifold $(S^3/\Gamma, F)$ under the non-zero Morse index assumption.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对奇维紧空间形式上的 bumpy Finsler 度量，在所有可缩极小闭测地线 Morse 指标非零时，证明至少有 n+3 条此类闭测地线，并得到三维商空间的相应猜想情形。
analysis.breakthrough: 提高指定非退化条件下可缩原始轨道的数量下界。
analysis.limitations: 文中 minimal 指不是其他可缩闭轨的迭代，并非长度极小；非零指标假设不可略去。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
